name: preflight-ios-mcp

tools.name: simulator_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the iOS Simulator screen. Returns the image directly for viewing.

format.description: Image format (default: jpeg). JPEG recommended for AI — smaller, faster.

mask.description: For non-rectangular displays, handle mask by policy

savePath.description: Optional: save a copy to this path on disk

tools.name: simulator_list_devices
tools.description: List iOS Simulator devices. Shows name, UDID, state, and runtime.

tools.name: simulator_list_apps
tools.description: List all installed apps on the simulator with their bundle IDs.

tools.name: simulator_app_info
tools.description: Get detailed metadata about an installed app (bundle ID, paths, version, etc.).

tools.name: simulator_get_clipboard
tools.description: Read the text content of the simulator clipboard.

tools.name: simulator_get_screen_info
tools.description: Get diagnostic info about the Simulator window geometry and coordinate mapping. Useful for debugging tap/swipe accuracy.

tools.name: simulator_tap
tools.description: Tap at a point on the simulator screen. Coordinates are in simulator screen points (e.g., 0-393 for iPhone width). Take a screenshot first to identify coordinates.

x.description: X coordinate in simulator screen points

y.description: Y coordinate in simulator screen points

duration.description: Press duration in seconds (decimal allowed, e.g. 0.5). Default: normal tap

tools.name: simulator_swipe
tools.description: Swipe/drag from one point to another on the simulator screen. Coordinates are in simulator screen points. Use for scrolling, pulling down, or any drag gesture.

startX.description: Start X in simulator screen points. Use 1 to trigger iOS left-edge-swipe-back gesture (iOS recognizes edge touches within ~20pt of edge)

startY.description: Start Y in simulator screen points

endX.description: End X in simulator screen points

endY.description: End Y in simulator screen points

durationMs.description: Swipe duration in milliseconds (default: 300). Use 400-600ms for edge-swipe-back

delta.description: Step size in pixels between each touch point (idb only, default: device decides)

tools.name: simulator_long_press
tools.description: Long press at a point on the simulator screen. Useful for context menus, drag-and-drop initiation, etc.

x.description: X coordinate in simulator screen points

y.description: Y coordinate in simulator screen points

tools.name: simulator_describe_point
tools.description: Returns the accessibility element at given coordinates on the iOS Simulator screen. Shows element type, label, value, and frame.

x.description: X coordinate in simulator screen points

y.description: Y coordinate in simulator screen points

tools.name: simulator_type_text
tools.description: Type text into the currently focused text field in the simulator. Make sure a text field is focused first (tap on it).

text.description: Text to type into the currently focused field

tools.name: simulator_press_key
tools.description: Press a special key (return, escape, delete, tab, arrows, etc.) with optional modifiers (command, shift, option, control).

key.description: Key name: return, escape, delete, tab, space, up, down, left, right, home, end, pageup, pagedown, f1-f12

modifiers.description: Modifier keys: command, shift, option, control

tools.name: simulator_boot
tools.description: Boot an iOS Simulator device. Opens the Simulator app. Use simulator_list_devices to find device names/UDIDs.

deviceId.description: Device UDID or name to boot

waitForBoot.description: Wait until device is fully booted before returning (default: true)

tools.name: simulator_shutdown
tools.description: Shut down a running simulator device.

tools.name: simulator_erase
tools.description: Factory reset a simulator device. Erases all content and settings.

deviceId.description: Device UDID or name to erase (factory reset)

tools.name: simulator_open_url
tools.description: Open a URL or deep link in the simulator (e.g., "https://example.com" or "myapp://screen").

url.description: URL or deep link to open (e.g., "https://example.com" or "myapp://path")

tools.name: simulator_open_simulator
tools.description: Opens the iOS Simulator application.

tools.name: simulator_get_booted_sim_id
tools.description: Get the UDID of the currently booted iOS Simulator.

tools.name: simulator_launch_app
tools.description: Launch an app by bundle ID. Optionally pass launch arguments and environment variables.

terminateRunning.description: Terminate the app first if already running (default: false)

args.description: Launch arguments to pass to the app

env.description: Environment variables to set (will be prefixed with SIMCTL_CHILD_)

tools.name: simulator_terminate_app
tools.description: Force-terminate a running app by bundle ID.

tools.name: simulator_install_app
tools.description: Install a .app bundle onto the simulator from a local file path.

path.description: Path to .app bundle or .ipa file to install

tools.name: simulator_uninstall_app
tools.description: Uninstall an app from the simulator by bundle ID.

tools.name: simulator_get_logs
tools.description: Get recent device/app logs. Filter by process name, subsystem, log level, time range, and message content. Essential for debugging app behavior.

limit.description: Max number of log lines to return (default: 100)

tools.name: simulator_stream_logs
tools.description: Start/read/stop a live log stream. Use action="start" to begin, "read" to get the buffer, "stop" to end. Great for watching app behavior in real-time.

action.description: "start" begins streaming, "read" returns current buffer, "stop" ends the stream

bufferSize.description: Max lines to keep in buffer (default: 200)

tools.name: simulator_get_app_container
tools.description: Get the filesystem path to an app's container (bundle, data, or shared groups). Use this to find where the app stores its files.

tools.name: simulator_list_app_files
tools.description: List files in an app's data container. Shows Documents, Library, Preferences, Caches, tmp, etc. Use to find databases, plists, caches.

tools.name: simulator_read_app_file
tools.description: Read a file from an app's data container. Handles plists (converts to JSON), SQLite databases (shows schema), and text files. Specify path relative to data container.

filePath.description: Relative path within the data container (e.g., "Documents/data.json", "Library/Preferences/com.app.plist")

tools.name: simulator_get_crash_logs
tools.description: Retrieve crash reports from ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/. Shows stack traces, exception info, and thread states. Filter by process name.

since.description: Only crashes since this ISO date (e.g., "2026-03-22")

tools.name: simulator_diagnose
tools.description: Generate a diagnostic summary: booted devices, Xcode version, disk usage, and system info.

tools.name: simulator_accessibility_audit
tools.description: Get the accessibility element tree of the current Simulator screen. Shows roles, labels, values, and positions of UI elements.

tools.name: simulator_set_location
tools.description: Set the simulated GPS location (latitude, longitude). Useful for testing location-based features.

tools.name: simulator_send_push
tools.description: Send a push notification to an app. Provide the full APNs payload JSON (e.g., {"aps": {"alert": "Hello"}}).

bundleId.description: App bundle ID to receive the push

tools.name: simulator_set_clipboard
tools.description: Set text on the simulator clipboard. Useful for pasting content into apps.

text.description: Text to copy to simulator clipboard

tools.name: simulator_add_media
tools.description: Add photos or videos to the simulator's camera roll from local file paths.

filePaths.description: Paths to photo/video files to add to camera roll

tools.name: simulator_grant_permission
tools.description: Grant, revoke, or reset app permissions (camera, location, photos, contacts, microphone, etc.).

service.description: Permission service: all, calendar, contacts-limited, contacts, location, location-always, photos-add, photos, media-library, microphone, motion, reminders, siri

tools.name: simulator_set_appearance
tools.description: Switch the simulator between light and dark mode.

tools.name: simulator_override_status_bar
tools.description: Override the simulator status bar: set time, battery, signal bars, carrier name, network type. Use clear=true to reset.

networkType.description: Data network type: wifi, 3g, 4g, lte, lte-a, lte+, 5g, 5g+, 5g-uwb, 5g-uc

clear.description: Set to true to clear all overrides

tools.name: simulator_record_video
tools.description: Start recording the simulator screen to a video file. Use simulator_stop_recording to stop. Supports H.264 and HEVC codecs.

mask.description: For non-rectangular displays, handle mask by policy

tools.name: simulator_stop_recording
tools.description: Stop an active video recording and save the file.

savePath.description: Optional: save the video file to this path instead of discarding it

maxFrames.description: Max number of key frames to extract (default: 3, max: 6)

tools.name: simulator_navigate_back
tools.description: Navigate back in the current app. Sends Cmd+[ (standard back navigation). Works in Safari and apps with standard UINavigationController. Workaround for edge-swipe-back gesture limitation.

tools.name: simulator_icloud_sync
tools.description: Trigger iCloud sync on the device. Requires the device to be signed into an Apple ID.

tools.name: simulator_keychain
tools.description: Manipulate the device keychain: add root certificates, add certificates, or reset the entire keychain.

action.description: "add-root-cert" to add trusted root CA, "add-cert" to add certificate, "reset" to clear keychain

path.description: Path to certificate file (required for add-root-cert and add-cert)

tools.name: simulator_set_content_size
tools.description: Set the preferred content size for Dynamic Type testing. Test your app with accessibility text sizes without changing device settings manually.

size.description: Preferred content size category for Dynamic Type testing

tools.name: simulator_set_increase_contrast
tools.description: Enable or disable the Increase Contrast accessibility setting. Test how your app responds to high contrast mode.

enabled.description: Enable or disable Increase Contrast accessibility setting

tools.name: simulator_location_scenario
tools.description: Run predefined GPS location scenarios (Freeway Drive, City Run, City Bicycle Ride). Simulates realistic movement patterns for testing location features.

action.description: "list" available scenarios, "run" a scenario, "clear" to stop

scenario.description: Scenario name (e.g., "Freeway Drive", "City Run", "City Bicycle Ride", "Apple")

tools.name: simulator_location_route
tools.description: Simulate movement along a custom route with waypoints. Specify GPS coordinates and speed for realistic location testing.

waypoints.description: Array of {lat, lng} waypoints to traverse

tools.name: simulator_verbose_logging
tools.description: Enable or disable verbose device logging for deep debugging. Requires device reboot to take effect.

enabled.description: Enable or disable verbose logging (device reboot may be required)

tools.name: simulator_install_app_data
tools.description: Install an .xcappdata package to replace the current app container contents. Useful for restoring test data snapshots.

tools.name: simulator_get_env
tools.description: Read an environment variable from the running simulator device (e.g., HOME, TMPDIR, PATH).

tools.name: simulator_memory_warning
tools.description: Trigger a simulated memory warning. Apps will receive didReceiveMemoryWarning and can be tested for proper memory cleanup.

tools.name: simulator_biometric
tools.description: Control Face ID / Touch ID: enroll, unenroll, trigger matching (success), or trigger failure. Test biometric authentication flows end-to-end.

action.description: "enroll" to enable biometrics, "unenroll" to disable, "match" to simulate successful auth, "fail" to simulate failed auth

enrolled.description: (Deprecated: use action instead) Whether Face ID / Touch ID is enrolled

tools.name: simulator_network_status
tools.description: Get the current network configuration inside the simulator — interfaces, IP addresses, DNS config.

tools.name: simulator_defaults_read
tools.description: Read UserDefaults values from inside the simulator. Inspect app preferences, feature flags, and configuration.

key.description: Specific key to read (omit for all keys)

tools.name: simulator_defaults_write
tools.description: Write UserDefaults values inside the simulator. Set feature flags, change app configuration, or inject test data.

tools.name: simulator_snapshot
tools.description: Capture a structured accessibility snapshot of the current screen — like Playwright's browser_snapshot. Returns roles, labels, values, and positions. PREFERRED over screenshots for understanding UI structure and targeting interactions. No vision model needed.

tools.name: simulator_wait_for_element
tools.description: Wait for an accessibility element to appear on screen. Polls until the element matching your criteria (label, role, or text) appears, or times out. Like Playwright's browser_wait_for.

label.description: Wait for element with this accessibility label (case-insensitive partial match)

role.description: Wait for element with this role (e.g., "Button", "TextField", "StaticText")

text.description: Wait for element containing this text in label or value

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check in milliseconds (default: 500)

tools.name: simulator_element_exists
tools.description: Quick check: does an element matching your criteria exist on screen right now? Returns true/false. Useful for conditional logic.

label.description: Search for element with this accessibility label (case-insensitive partial match)

role.description: Search for element with this role

text.description: Search for element containing this text

tools.name: simulator_storekit_config
tools.description: Enable or disable StoreKit testing on the simulator. Required before using other StoreKit tools.

action.description: Enable or disable StoreKit testing on the simulator

tools.name: simulator_storekit_transactions
tools.description: List all StoreKit test transactions (purchases, subscriptions, etc.).

tools.name: simulator_storekit_delete_transactions
tools.description: Delete all StoreKit test transactions. Clears purchase history for fresh testing.

tools.name: simulator_storekit_manage_subscription
tools.description: Expire or force-renew a StoreKit test subscription by transaction ID.

action.description: "expire" to expire a subscription, "renew" to force renewal

tools.name: simulator_storekit_manage_transaction
tools.description: Refund, approve, or decline ask-to-buy for a StoreKit test transaction.

tools.name: simulator_storekit_reset_eligibility
tools.description: Reset introductory offer eligibility for all StoreKit products. Allows re-testing intro pricing.

tools.name: simulator_network_condition
tools.description: Apply network throttling: bandwidth limits, latency, and packet loss. Presets: 3G, LTE, Edge, WiFi, WiFi-lossy, 100%-loss (offline). Simulator shares host network stack, so conditioning affects all simulator traffic.

action.description: "set" to apply conditioning, "clear" to remove, "list-presets" to show available presets

preset.description: Network preset name, or "custom" to specify parameters manually

bandwidth.description: Custom bandwidth (e.g., "1Mbit/s", "500Kbit/s"). Required when preset is "custom"

delay.description: Custom latency in milliseconds. Required when preset is "custom"

packetLossRate.description: Custom packet loss rate 0.0-1.0 (e.g., 0.05 = 5%). Required when preset is "custom"

tools.name: simulator_network_capture
tools.description: Capture a snapshot of network activity: active TCP connections, DNS resolution, host interfaces, and any active network conditioning.

bundleId.description: App bundle ID to filter network activity for (optional — shows all if omitted)

tools.name: simulator_leak_check
tools.description: Check a running app for memory leaks using Apple's leaks tool. Returns leak count, leaked bytes, and details.

bundleId.description: Bundle ID of the running app to check for leaks

tools.name: simulator_heap_info
tools.description: Dump heap allocation summary for a running app. Shows object counts by class and total memory usage.

bundleId.description: Bundle ID of the running app to analyze heap

tools.name: simulator_vmmap
tools.description: Show virtual memory map for a running app. Displays memory regions, sizes, and permissions. Useful for diagnosing memory issues.

bundleId.description: Bundle ID of the running app to inspect virtual memory

summary.description: Show summary only instead of full map (default: true)

tools.name: simulator_sample_process
tools.description: Sample a running app's CPU activity for a few seconds. Returns call stack tree — useful for finding performance hotspots and hangs.

bundleId.description: Bundle ID of the running app to sample

tools.name: simulator_thermal_state
tools.description: Simulate thermal pressure changes (nominal, fair, serious, critical). Test how your app responds to device overheating.

tools.name: simulator_set_reduce_motion
tools.description: Enable or disable the Reduce Motion accessibility setting. Test animations and transitions with motion sensitivity.

enabled.description: Enable or disable Reduce Motion accessibility setting

tools.name: simulator_set_smart_invert
tools.description: Enable or disable Smart Invert Colors. Test how your app handles inverted color schemes.

enabled.description: Enable or disable Smart Invert Colors

tools.name: simulator_set_bold_text
tools.description: Enable or disable Bold Text accessibility setting. Test text rendering with bold system fonts.

tools.name: simulator_set_reduce_transparency
tools.description: Enable or disable Reduce Transparency. Test UI readability without blur/vibrancy effects.

tools.name: simulator_create_device
tools.description: Create a new simulator device. Specify name and device type; auto-detects latest iOS runtime if not provided.

name.description: Name for the new device (e.g., "My Test iPhone")

deviceType.description: Device type (e.g., "iPhone 16", "iPad Air"). Use simulator_list_devices to see available types.

runtime.description: Runtime identifier (e.g., "iOS-18-0"). Default: latest available iOS runtime.

tools.name: simulator_delete_device
tools.description: Permanently delete a simulator device by UDID or name.

deviceId.description: Device UDID or name to delete permanently

tools.name: simulator_rename_device
tools.description: Rename a simulator device.

tools.name: simulator_clone_device
tools.description: Clone a simulator device with all its current state — apps, data, settings.

deviceId.description: Device UDID or name to clone

tools.name: simulator_rotate
tools.description: Rotate the simulator device left or right. Uses Cmd+Arrow keyboard shortcut in Simulator.app.

tools.name: simulator_notify_post
tools.description: Post a Darwin notification inside the simulator. Useful for triggering system events or testing notification observers.

tools.name: simulator_set_locale
tools.description: Set the device locale and language for internationalization testing. Requires device reboot to take effect.

language.description: Language identifier (e.g., "en", "ja", "fr"). If omitted, derived from locale

tools.name: simulator_trigger_siri
tools.description: Invoke Siri on the simulator. Use simulator_type_text to enter a query if text input is available.
